Reference2 is its TRUE FLOOR PLAN: all six pavilions must be positioned exactly as this rectangular plan. Four at the corners plus one at the EXACT MIDPOINT of each long wing, opposite one another. Do NOT offset either midpoint pavilion towards a corner. Closed four-wing rectangular palace, open deep courtyard. Same 860x360 overall proportion and same building design, no added wings.
MOST IMPORTANT: reveal all four BASE CORNERS of ALL THREE pyramids. Keep the central pyramid just as LARGE as in the references and the two smaller pyramids to either side. Three solid bright BLUE pyramids with strong darker diamond grid, opaque surfaces, no paving visible through them, no reflections. Stone and gray roofs stay their own colors. Four tall corner pavilions, two slightly lower middle pavilions, matching reference architecture and heights. Every pyramid is freestanding, separated visually from the palace. Courtyard paving is deep below roofs, with visible vertical inner walls and open arcades; courtyard is NOT a solid raised infill.
Frame whole building safely inside1536x1024 with generous blank margins. Flat diffuse light and plain uniform light gray background. No cast shadows, no ground outside courtyard, no trees, people, text, labels, extra buildings, border or watermark. Complete new rendering; preserve all prior images.
